slide_plan.title: Kyoto, at our own pace
slide_plan.message: Four autumn days with room for everyone.
slide_plan.evidence: Family of four; children aged 8 and 11; mid-November; leaves, animals, snacks and a quiet garden pause.
slide_plan.visual: Wide river and maple landscape, left calm sky and water for a large cover title; no parallel list.

slide_plan.title: Ease in. Then chase the leaves.
slide_plan.message: Days 1–2 balance arrival snacks and a temple garden.
slide_plan.evidence: Plan Day 1: settle in, Nishiki Market snack stop, early night. Day 2: Tenryu-ji garden, optional riverside walk in Arashiyama; quiet observation challenge.
slide_plan.visual: Temple pond landscape right; two generous icon-led day rows left, with small planned day labels and native thin dividing rule.

slide_plan.title: Animals first. A gentle finish.
slide_plan.message: Days 3–4 satisfy animal lovers without rushing departure.
slide_plan.evidence: Plan Day 3: Kyoto City Zoo, lunch and Okazaki stroll. Day 4: Kyoto Aquarium only if departure allows; otherwise relaxed breakfast, bags, onward travel. Check closure dates and swap days.
slide_plan.visual: Watery aquarium scene across bottom-left, open pale wall right for two animal-themed day rows.

slide_plan.title: Pack light. Stay comfortable.
slide_plan.message: Three small packing kits cover changing weather and walking.
slide_plan.evidence: Warm layers, rain layer and worn-in shoes; water/snacks/tissues; adult-held travel essentials and family medicines.
slide_plan.visual: Top-down packing scene at lower-right, three icon-led rows left in open bedding area.

slide_plan.title: Our travel-day pact
slide_plan.message: Stay together, travel calmly, stop to snack.
slide_plan.evidence: One adult with each child, count four at each change; let others off, quiet voices, bags close; Nishiki snacks at shop; tell an adult when tired.
slide_plan.visual: Native connected three-step travel sequence across one translucent reading lane, above station scenery; separate closing family check-in note.
